scope: Uganda–Rwanda designated land posts and Uganda–DRC independently documented ground entry locations; additional lake/service points retained outside road benchmark
coverage_limitations: This is an independently sourced benchmark, not a complete inventory of all formal and informal crossings.
Source-verified means the named crossing or entry location is documented; it does not mean its current operation, exact gate coordinate, road suitability or a historical closure has been verified.
Rwanda six-post designation is explicit. DRC list combines national service directories and humanitarian reference data with different purposes.

No candidate is accepted solely because a similarly named settlement is nearby. Supported locations combine independent coordinates with the correct frontier and route evidence; source accuracy is unspecified.
2021 GPS data predates the 2026 OSM extract. Relocated facilities and changed roads require historical checks.
DRC post counterparts outside the extract, informal paths and lake connections are incomplete.
Unresolved named facilities must not be counted as closed, open, absent, or false OSM detections.

UNHCR coordinates are externally published reference positions. Their collection method, per-point observation date, accuracy and independence from OSM are undocumented; publication date is not observation date.

findings: UNHCR 2021 provides independent coordinates for many west-frontier locations, materially improving on nearest-town suggestions.
Busanza in the closure records is a distinct Kisoro/Kitagoma location; old matches near Ishasha and Bunagana are unsupported homonyms.
Kyeshero and Butogo align with unclassified/track candidates; limiting inventory to primary and secondary roads misses documented entry points.
Butogota reference is inland and near Kyeshero; assigning both labels to one nearest contact would invent a second facility.
Six Rwanda designated posts include Buhita, Buziba and Rwempasha. Their exact post coordinates remain unresolved despite nearby road suggestions.
Vurra Custom Road has multiple boundary contacts, so its name does not by itself resolve the true facility.
Independent primary-source point positions support nine selected candidate identities, but source precision and gate-level accuracy remain qualified.
